supporting_local_evidence: ~/.config/opencode/MIGRATION.md:176 documents the command shape {"template": "... $ARGUMENTS"} for user input.
~/.config/opencode/MIGRATION.md:190 and :333 document $ARGUMENTS as the placeholder inside a command template.

Both declared e2e surfaces use template "{file:commands/e2e.md}\n\n$ARGUMENTS" (project .opencode/opencode.json and global ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json), i.e. the raw argument string is appended after the file body.
ASM-01/ARGS.consequence_for_m2: M2 prompt-side grammar must treat the trailing argument string as one opaque token sequence and parse it itself; it must not rely on runtime-side subcommand or flag semantics.

ASM-01/PRECEDENCE.why_not_promoted: Producing a winner requires executing /e2e help in each of candidates A-D and reading the echoed sentinel. Every available invocation path expands a command template only through a model turn (session.command / session.prompt), which is a network and cost action excluded by the milestone guardrails. Reporting a winner from source-order alone would be an assumption, not evidence.
ASM-01/PRECEDENCE.consequence_for_m2: M2 output is contract-bound to behaviour, not to a file location, so the unresolved winner does not block the parser, validators, resolver or fixture work. Live prompt verification stays DEFERRED_TO_M6 and the gate stays VALIDATION_REQUIRED. M5 parity/disable-default work (DEC-10) must treat the winner as unknown.
